IdempotencyKey.description: 8-128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - : .`. Reuse the same key to retry the same order safely.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

Limit.description: Page size, 1-100 (an out-of-range value falls back to 15).
Limit.name: limit

Conflict.description: An earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running (`CONFLICT`). Retry shortly.

Forbidden.description: `FORBIDDEN` (account not active, or not allowed to do this), `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` or `IP_NOT_ALLOWED`.

InsufficientBalance.description: The wallet cannot cover the order (`INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`).

NotFound.description: No such resource in your account (`NOT_FOUND`).

RateLimited.description: Too many requests (`RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`). Back off; honour `Retry-After` when present.

ServerActionAccepted.description: The operation was accepted and is running.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token (`UNAUTHORIZED`).

Unavailable.description: The platform is temporarily unreachable (`UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, `WRITES_UNAVAILABLE`). Retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

Unprocessable.description: The request is well formed but cannot be done now (`VALIDATION_ERROR`), for example the server is protected, the plan is sold out, or an Idempotency-Key was reused with a different body. `FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED` means the datacenter does not offer the requested resource (a firewall or SSH key); check `supports` in `GET /regions`.

Upstream.description: The platform could not complete the request (`UPSTREAM_ERROR`). Nothing is exposed about why; retry, and contact support if it persists.

currency_id.description: Wallet currency to pay with. Defaults to the currency of your primary wallet (`NO_DEFAULT_WALLET` if there is none).

hostnames.description: Alias of `hostname`; wins when both are sent.

ssh_key_id.description: Required when `auth_type` is `ssh` (`auth_id` is accepted as an alias).

CreatedServer.description: What is known the moment creation is accepted. IP addresses usually appear a little later; read the server again.

root_password.description: Returned only here (and on an idempotent replay). Absent for ssh-key servers.

supports.description: Optional resources this datacenter offers. Creating one where it is `false` is refused with `422 FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED`.

id.description: Identifier to delete the rule with.

prefix.description: First characters of the token, to recognise it.

BearerAuth.description:
Personal API token. Scopes a token may carry: `regions:read`, `os:read`,
`plans:read`, `servers:read`, `servers:write`, `balance:read`, `invoices:read`,
`ssh-keys:read`, `ssh-keys:write`, `firewalls:read`, `firewalls:write`,
`tokens:read`, `tokens:write`. A token with no scopes may do everything.

info.description:
Public web service for buying and managing Arianet cloud servers. It is the
same service the `arianet` CLI, the Telegram bot and partner integrations use.

## Authentication

Every endpoint needs a personal API token created in the panel
(**Settings → API Tokens**), sent as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

A token can be restricted to a set of **scopes** and to an **IP allowlist**.
A token created without scopes is unrestricted. A request outside the token's
scopes answers `403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`; from a disallowed address,
`403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED`.

## Response envelope

```json
{ "success": true, "data": { } }
{ "success": true, "data": [ ], "pagination": { "current_page": 1, "per_page": 15, "total": 40, "last_page": 3 } }
{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE", "message": "Not enough balance. Required balance: 4.50" } }
```

Branch on `error.code`; `error.message` is for humans and may change.

## Asynchronous operations

Creating, deleting, reinstalling, restarting and powering a server on or off
answer **202 Accepted**: the request was validated and started, the work is
not finished. Poll `GET /servers/{id}/status` until `status` is `active` and
`instance_status` is `RUNNING` (or `STOPPED` after a power-off), or read `GET /servers/{id}/actions` for the operation history.

## Idempotency

`POST /servers` spends money, so it requires an `Idempotency-Key` header
(8-128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - : .`, for example a UUID). Retrying with
the same key and the same body never buys a second server: the original answer
is replayed for 24 hours with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The same
key with a different body answers `422`; a retry while the first request is
still running answers `409 CONFLICT` - wait a few seconds and retry.
Treat the key like a secret: the replayed answer contains the root password.

## Rate limits

Limits are per user (creation: per token). When exceeded the API answers
`429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`; creation also sends `Retry-After`.

| Group | Limit |
|---|---|
| Reads | 120 / minute, burst 20 |
| Writes (actions, ssh keys, firewalls, tokens) | about 20 / minute, burst 5 |
| `POST /servers` | 5 / hour sustained per token, plus 10 / hour per account |

post.description:
Needs scope `servers:write`. The cost is reserved from the wallet at once.
Answers **202**: the server is being provisioned, poll it until it is `active`.

Authentication is either `password` (default; `auth_value` is the root
password) or `ssh` (`ssh_key_id` of one of your SSH keys). The generated
or chosen root password is returned in this response only.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this is the stored answer of an earlier request with the same key.

delete.description:
Needs scope `servers:write`. Irreversible; a protected server must have
protection switched off first. Answers **202**.

reason.description: Why the server is deleted (defaults to `other`).

post.description: Needs scope `servers:write`. A powered-off server may still be billed.
Needs scope `servers:write`. **Erases all data on the server.** Answers 202.

Needs scope `servers:write`. With `{"enabled": true|false}` the state is set
explicitly; with no body it flips the current state. Prefer the explicit form.
Needs scope `ssh-keys:write`. A key belongs to one datacenter, because providers keep keys per location.

delete.description: Needs scope `ssh-keys:write`. Servers already created with the key are not affected.

put.description: Needs scope `ssh-keys:write`. At least one field is required; the key material itself cannot be changed.
